test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 16 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: As per the India State of Forest Report (ISFR) 2021, which of the following is the state with the least forest cover with respect to the total geographical area in India?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Haryana__**

**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• India State of Forest Report (ISFR) ​

 
 
• The** country's forest cover and tree cover** are reported in the **India State of Forest Report (ISFR)** 2021.
 
• The first survey was released in **1987**, and they are now published every two years. The** Forest Survey of India **(FSI), **17th edition** of ISFR is currently available.
 
• India's entire forest and tree cover **7,13,789 square kilometres or 24.62 per cent **of the country's total geographical area.
 
• **Haryana's** forest cover is only **1588 sq kilometres or 3.59%** of the state's overall geographic area.
 
• Since **agriculture** is Haryana's primary industry, the majority of its land has been utilized.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Top three states with the greatest increase in forest cover are:**

 
 
• Andhra Pradesh (647 sq km)
 
• Telangana (632 sq km)
 
• Odisha (537 sq km) 
 
 
 
• The overall area covered by trees and forests in the country has increased by **2,261 sq km** since the assessment of **2019**. Out of this, an increase in forest cover of **1,540 sq km** and an increase in tree cover of** 721 sq km** have been noted.
